title: 橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換
subcategoryTitle: 支承、伸縮縫與橋梁耐震
subcategoryTitleEn: Bearings, joints and bridge seismic design
summary: 從溫度、乾縮、潛變與活載造成的梁端位移出發，決定伸縮縫型式與間隙數，檢核中梁輪載衝擊與疲勞，再處理錨碇箱與後澆混凝土、安裝溫度預設、通車條件下的分幅更換、出廠疲勞與防水試驗、現場間隙—溫度量測，最後以止水排水維護與生命週期更換策略交接，並以新 Tappan Zee 橋的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫、Øresund 橋的旋轉橫梁伸縮縫更換與漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋伸縮縫翻修為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from girder-end movements due to temperature, shrinkage, creep and live load, choose the joint type and number of gaps and check centre-beam wheel impact and fatigue, then handle anchorage boxes and blockout concrete, temperature presetting at installation, staged replacement under traffic, factory fatigue and watertightness tests and field gap–temperature measurements, and finally hand over with seal and drainage maintenance and a life-cycle replacement strategy, using the LR18 modular joints of the new Tappan Zee crossing, the swivel-joist joint replacement on the Øresund Bridge and the joint rehabilitation of Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge as cases.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」與「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range" and "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「設計伸縮量」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design movement range” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。梁端位移的主要來源是溫度變化，混凝土橋另有乾縮與潛變造成的單向縮短，長跨橋還有活載、風與煞車造成的往復位移，耐震設計可能再加上地震位移。伸縮量由固定點到伸縮縫之間的伸縮長度決定，所以支承配置與固定點位置改變，伸縮縫需求也隨之改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「設計伸縮量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps. The main source of movement is temperature; concrete bridges add one-way shortening from shrinkage and creep, long spans add cyclic movements from live load, wind and braking, and seismic design may add earthquake displacement. The movement is governed by the expansion length between the fixed point and the joint, so changing the bearing layout or fixed point changes the joint demand too. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Design movement range” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「設計伸縮量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Design movement range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求
knowledge.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。梁端位移的主要來源是溫度變化，混凝土橋另有乾縮與潛變造成的單向縮短，長跨橋還有活載、風與煞車造成的往復位移，耐震設計可能再加上地震位移。
knowledge.textEn: An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps. The main source of movement is temperature; concrete bridges add one-way shortening from shrinkage and creep, long spans add cyclic movements from live load, wind and braking, and seismic design may add earthquake displacement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換」的「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「跨河橋梁試載日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: mechanism and load path” in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Bridge proof-test day” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。
伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。
伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
optionsEn: Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change.

An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps.
An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計伸縮量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Design movement range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預力混凝土橋伸縮長度 L = 300 m：溫度 ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm；殘餘乾縮 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm；潛變 (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm。合計 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm，若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 274/80 ≈ 3.4，取 4 個間隙（320 mm）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. The total, 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm, at 80 mm per modular gap needs 274/80 ≈ 3.4, so 4 gaps (320 mm). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. The total, 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm, at 80 mm per modular gap needs 274/80 ≈ 3.4, so 4 gaps (320 mm). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range", which statement holds?
options: 後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。
更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
預力混凝土橋伸縮長度 L = 300 m：溫度 ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm。
optionsEn: Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back.
Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm.
quiz.explanationEn: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設計伸縮量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Design movement range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：伸縮縫規格須列出各方向設計位移、轉角、可逆與單向分量、地震設計策略（容納或可犧牲），以及安裝時的預設計算方法，並與支承規格一起審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The joint specification must list design movements in each direction, rotations, reversible and one-way components, the seismic strategy (accommodate or sacrificial) and the presetting method, and be reviewed together with the bearing specification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫規格須列出各方向設計位移、轉角、可逆與單向分量、地震設計策略（容納或可犧牲），以及安裝時的預設計算方法，並與支承規格一起審查。
knowledge.textEn: The joint specification must list design movements in each direction, rotations, reversible and one-way components, the seismic strategy (accommodate or sacrificial) and the presetting method, and be reviewed together with the bearing specification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range"?
options: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。
optionsEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.
quiz.explanation: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設計伸縮量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Design movement range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：伸縮量由固定點到伸縮縫之間的伸縮長度決定，所以支承配置與固定點位置改變，伸縮縫需求也隨之改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The movement is governed by the expansion length between the fixed point and the joint, so changing the bearing layout or fixed point changes the joint demand too.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統。
伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system.
An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
quiz.explanation: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「中梁輪載衝擊」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Centre-beam wheel impact” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫直接承受車輪衝擊：輪胎從橋面滾到鋼梁再滾回橋面，路面的高低差與間隙造成衝擊，動態放大比一般橋面更大；車輛煞車與加速又在縫面上施加水平力。模組式伸縮縫的中梁像一根多跨連續梁，擱在間距約一公尺多的支撐梁上，每一次車輪通過都在中梁與支撐梁的焊接或連接處產生應力循環，所以疲勞是模組式伸縮縫最主要的結構問題，美國 NCHRP 的研究與 AASHTO 規範都要求以疲勞試驗驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「中梁輪載衝擊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Expansion joints take wheel impact directly: as a tyre rolls from the deck onto steel beams and back, steps and gaps cause impact with larger dynamic amplification than elsewhere on the deck, and braking and acceleration apply horizontal forces at the surface. In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Centre-beam wheel impact” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「中梁輪載衝擊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Centre-beam wheel impact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞
knowledge.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue

In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。
模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
伸縮縫直接承受車輪衝擊：輪胎從橋面滾到鋼梁再滾回橋面，路面的高低差與間隙造成衝擊，動態放大比一般橋面更大；車輛煞車與加速又在縫面上施加水平力。
optionsEn: An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.

Expansion joints take wheel impact directly: as a tyre rolls from the deck onto steel beams and back, steps and gaps cause impact with larger dynamic amplification than elsewhere on the deck, and braking and acceleration apply horizontal forces at the surface.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫直接承受車輪衝擊：輪胎從橋面滾到鋼梁再滾回橋面，路面的高低差與間隙造成衝擊，動態放大比一般橋面更大；車輛煞車與加速又在縫面上施加水平力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Expansion joints take wheel impact directly: as a tyre rolls from the deck onto steel beams and back, steps and gaps cause impact with larger dynamic amplification than elsewhere on the deck, and braking and acceleration apply horizontal forces at the surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中梁輪載衝擊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Centre-beam wheel impact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue", which statement holds?
options: 輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN。
伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。
只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。
optionsEn: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN.
A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with.
If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed.
quiz.explanation: 輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中梁輪載衝擊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Centre-beam wheel impact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規格要求依交通量分級的疲勞試驗與型式認證，並規定縫面與鋪面高差允差；重車比例高的路段應優先採用經試驗驗證的連接細部，並把伸縮縫列入每次例行檢查的必看項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Procurement should require fatigue testing and type approval graded by traffic, and a flushness tolerance between joint and pavement; routes with heavy truck traffic should favour connection details proven by testing, and joints are a mandatory item at every routine inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。
knowledge.textEn: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購規格要求依交通量分級的疲勞試驗與型式認證，並規定縫面與鋪面高差允差；重車比例高的路段應優先採用經試驗驗證的連接細部，並把伸縮縫列入每次例行檢查的必看項目。
knowledge.textEn: Procurement should require fatigue testing and type approval graded by traffic, and a flushness tolerance between joint and pavement; routes with heavy truck traffic should favour connection details proven by testing, and joints are a mandatory item at every routine inspection.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核。
伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic.
A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement.
quiz.explanation: 製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中梁輪載衝擊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Centre-beam wheel impact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模組式伸縮縫的中梁像一根多跨連續梁，擱在間距約一公尺多的支撐梁上，每一次車輪通過都在中梁與支撐梁的焊接或連接處產生應力循環，所以疲勞是模組式伸縮縫最主要的結構問題，美國 NCHRP 的研究與 AASHTO 規範都要求以疲勞試驗驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。
knowledge.textEn: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.
The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard.
quiz.explanation: 中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
